# [Predefined Models of Quantum States](@id Predefined-Models-of-Quantum-States)

The submodule `QuantumSavory.StatesZoo` provides models for many frequently used quantum states.

The ranges returned by `stateparametersrange` are recommendations for exploration and
user-interface controls. They are not constructor validation rules. A state type's
constructors define which parameter values are accepted.
